messages:
Jordan: FYI — Cedar pilot flagged latency as a hard constraint. They mentioned a 50ms p95 bar in their ops checklist and said anything >150ms would be a deal risk. Can we scope what that actually means for the beta?
Priya: Wow, 50ms p95 is tight for generation. Are they measuring for single-turn embeddings or chat gen?
Jordan: Single-turn text generation for short prompts (avg 60 tokens). We pushed for a hybrid: 50ms p95 for cached/prefix hits, 150ms worst-case for cold KV cache. They want this in the renewal deck.
Sam: @Priya @Eli I can run a quick perf matrix tomorrow. Need to know model variant they're testing + sequence length distribution. Do we have their sample prompts?
Priya: I asked Cedar to share sample prompts; PMs sent a redacted set earlier today to my email. I can drop it here once sanitized.
Eli: Platform note: on hosted tier we have continuous batching that helps throughput but adds latency tail for small qps. Dedicated pools with small slab sizing + warmed KV cache give better p95. Could do a canary on Dedicated with pinned quantized fp16 model.
Anya: From CS side, we should align enablement: a preflight checklist for Cedar (network egress, KMS keys for Private, test tokens, expected traffic shape). Also propose a 'latency runbook' we can hand to their SREs.
Sam: Draft perf plan (quick sketch):
```
- model: gpt-open-7b-quant
- config: batch_size <= 4, max_seq 128
- warmup: 200 requests to populate KV cache
- metric: p95 latency over 1k requests
- fallback: route to smaller model if p95 > 200ms
```
I can run this against their prompts once we have samples.
Jordan: Nice. Also flagging renewal risk: customer noted "latency will drive adoption" in last call. Priya, can you surface this in the next CE sync and ask for priority of endpoints?
Priya: Yep — I'll call it out and ask for expected qps by endpoint. Would be helpful to know acceptable quality tradeoffs (quantization vs. output fidelity).
Eli: deploy-bot: Canary pool provisioned: pool-id cp-cedar-03, 4x A10G. Link: https://console.redwood/pools/cp-cedar-03
Sam: Thanks @deploy-bot. I'll queue the perf runs tomorrow AM PST and post results here. If p95 doesn't meet their bar, recommend: 1) switch to dedicated pool, 2) reduce concurrency, 3) enable prefix cache TTLs for the most common prompts.
Anya: I'll assemble the enablement doc + runbook and post a short checklist we can share with Cedar. Also prepping a short renewal note summarizing risk and mitigation options.
Priya: Sync outcome: Cedar wants a 1-week canary with telemetry (p95, p50, error rate, cost per 1k tokens). We'll propose dates after perf run. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Perfect. Thanks team — keep this thread updated.
